name: AlwaysBringAGift
description: Always Bring a Gift (ABAG) is a simple, self‑hosted gift‑tracking app designed to help you remember events, track people, and keep ideas organized across holidays, birthdays, and celebrations. Manage gift histories, plan ahead, and never forget what you gave—or meant to give—again. Perfect for families, busy schedules, and year‑round planning. (Beta release; features and UI may evolve.)
